title: Add permit number, furnishing status, and washrooms to Agent Arena + public listings and search

requirements.summary: Extend Agent Arena create/edit property form to capture Permit Number, Furnishing Status, and Washrooms and submit them in create/update requests.
acceptanceCriteria: On /agent/properties/new and /agent/properties/edit/:id, the form includes fields labeled in English: "Permit Number", "Furnishing Status", and "Washrooms".
Furnishing Status offers exactly 3 options: Furnished, Semi-Furnished, Unfurnished.
Creating a property saves these values; editing a property pre-fills the fields from existing listing data and saving updates them.
If required validation is applied, validation messages (if any) are in English.

file_operations.description: Add controlled form inputs for Permit Number (text), Furnishing Status (select with exactly: Furnished, Semi-Furnished, Unfurnished), and Washrooms (number). Extend PropertyForm props/initialData/onSubmit payload to include these fields, add basic numeric validation for washrooms (>= 0 or >= 1 as appropriate), and ensure all labels/messages are in English.

Wire the new PropertyForm fields into create/edit flows: map property.permitNumber, property.furnishingStatus, and property.numberOfWashrooms into initialData for edit mode; include the three fields in the handleSubmit payload; and pass them through to the create/update mutations so they are sent to the backend.

Extend useCreateProperty and useUpdateProperty mutation inputs to accept permitNumber, furnishingStatus, and numberOfWashrooms; include these fields when building CreatePropertyParams for create/update calls so Agent Arena submissions persist the values.

Confirm frontend type definitions include permitNumber, furnishingStatus, and numberOfWashrooms on Property and CreatePropertyParams, and update the declarations if needed so the Agent Arena form and mutations type-check correctly.

requirements.summary: Show Permit Number, Furnishing Status, and Washrooms on listing cards and the listing details page with clear English labels and graceful handling of missing values.
acceptanceCriteria: Property cards show the washrooms count and/or permit number in a readable way without breaking the existing layout.
Listing details page shows Permit Number, Furnishing Status, and Washrooms with English labels.
If a listing is missing one of these values (e.g., older data), the UI handles it gracefully (e.g., hides the row or shows "N/A" in English) without crashing.

file_operations.description: Update the property card UI to display washrooms count and/or permit number (e.g., as a compact metadata row). Ensure the layout remains intact and handle missing/empty values gracefully (hide the field or show "N/A" in English).

Add a clearly labeled details section for "Permit Number", "Furnishing Status", and "Washrooms". Map FurnishingStatus enum values to English labels (Furnished / Semi-Furnished / Unfurnished) and handle missing values by hiding the row or showing "N/A" in English without throwing.

requirements.summary: Add a public Furnishing Status filter to PropertySearchBar and ensure search results respect it when applied.
acceptanceCriteria: Public search UI includes a "Furnishing Status" filter with options: Furnished, Semi-Furnished, Unfurnished (and an empty/unset state).

When Furnishing Status is selected and the user clicks "Search Properties", the results list updates to include only listings matching that furnishing status (in addition to any other active filters).
When Furnishing Status is not selected, results behavior remains unchanged from before this update.
All user-facing text for this filter is in English.

file_operations.description: Add a new Select control labeled "Furnishing Status" with an empty/unset state plus exactly three options: Furnished, Semi-Furnished, Unfurnished. Extend the onSearch callback payload to include an optional furnishingStatus filter and ensure all text is English.

Extend the stored searchFilters state to include optional furnishingStatus, pass it from PropertySearchBar into the page state, and ensure triggering "Search Properties" updates results based on the furnishing status selection.

Update useSearchProperties to accept an optional furnishingStatus filter and apply it when fetching results. Prefer backend capabilities that support furnishing filtering (e.g., fetch by furnishing status directly when it is the only filter; when combined with other filters, use the strongest available backend capability and apply any remaining furnishing filtering on the frontend if needed) so results respect the filter while preserving prior behavior when unset.

Ensure FurnishingStatus enum and the relevant property query function type declarations are present/accurate for the new furnishing filter usage in PropertySearchBar/PublicListingsPage/useSearchProperties.
